groupings.title: The governed reporting core
groupings.description: One versioned directory of trusted, parametric SQL over your Unity Catalog semantic layer - the single definition of the numbers, with a validator that refuses the constructs which quietly make a report irreproducible.

groupings.title: Two consumers, same numbers
groupings.description: Promote that one contract in both directions - into a self-contained skill that renders a dashboard-grade HTML report, and into a Databricks App serving the very same queries - with a hash gate that fails the build the moment either copy drifts.
